reuse.why: Extends the existing single weekend-rule definition (applyWeekendRule / getDateWithSkippedWeekend) and threads the holidays through its existing callers instead of adding a parallel holiday check.

duplication.why: The moving logic is generalised in one place; the only repetition is passing `exdates: recurConfigToExdates(config)` next to every `recurConfigToRSchedule(config)` construction.

placement.why: Holiday logic lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend rule and recurrence builder, and the type change is in types/models/schedule.ts.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, its call-site plumbing, the widened lookaround window it needs, and tests.

maintainability.why: Daily-schedule skipping is split between recurConfigToRSchedule (weekends, via byDayOfWeek) and a separate recurConfigToExdates that each RSchedule construction must remember to pass; find-schedules.ts takeDates still builds the schedule without it, and the 14-day window is a magic bound.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every weekend-move call site passes holidays into applyWeekendRule; no site re-implements the move.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; the repeated exdates argument is plumbing, not a copied rule.

one_place.where: The move rule is in applyWeekendRule (one place), but daily skipping of holidays is a second helper, recurConfigToExdates, added by hand at rule-utils.ts parseRecurDate and schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange, and not at schedules/find-schedules.ts takeDates; it is not folded into recurConfigToRSchedule, which owns the weekend skip.
